About.title: Sabilul Huda Education Foundation
About.description: Sabilul Huda Education Foundation is a completely non-political, educational, dawah, self-purification, and humanitarian service organization. This foundation follows the ideal of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) — the messenger of peace and welfare for the world — providing services in Islamic culture promotion, social reform, employment creation, poverty alleviation, food distribution, educational project management, free or low-cost healthcare, building a clean mindset, and using modern media to call people towards the guidance of Allah and His Messenger, with the aim of building an ideal welfare society.
About.missionText: In the light of the Prophet's (PBUH) life guidance, to establish a welfare society through education, dawah, self-purification, and service programs — this is the mission and vision of Sabilul Huda Education Foundation-SHEF.
About.activitySubtitle: Sabilul Huda Education Foundation-SHEF primarily works in four sectors:
About.complexTitle: Sabilul Huda Mosque Complex & Islamic Center
About.complexDesc: Sabilul Huda Education Foundation-SHEF wants to build a Mosque Complex & Islamic Center as a center for all its welfare activities. From here, all education, dawah, self-purification, and service programs will be conducted nationwide.
About.complexFooter: We seek everyone's cooperation in building this complex and center.
